name: Encounter code review learning product
competency_questions: Which source records have respiratory-family codes?
Which evidence supports each review classification?
source_subset: 60 records; equal strata across three source diagnosis tokens
refresh_policy: Rebuild on accepted source, mapping or ontology changes; no claim of current clinical observations
access: Published learning subset; production access policy to be designed for its actual source
quality_gates: Complete import closure passes OWL 2 DL
reasoning: HermiT; named class memberships only exported to SPARQL
dependencies: Accepted local reporting mappings in ontology/taxonomies.ttl
support: File a reproducible issue with notebook, step, source and model versions; do not include new private clinical records
rollback: Restore prior source/model/mapping versions and rebuild derived graph
